rounds.title: Find The Connection
notes: Matt's parenthetical source list says Captain Phillips, but Question 3's answer is Marvel. rounds.scoringNote: GENEROUS SCORING: Q3 — accept Marvel, Marvel Comics, or Captain Marvel if the team clearly understands the clue/connection. Q8 — accept Captain, Captains, Captain-themed answers, Captain Marvel, Captain Phillips, or another clear Captain-based variation that demonstrates the connection. Do not penalize harmless singular/plural, punctuation, spelling, or wording differences.
